description.es-ES: Las vidas escritas por Fray Luis de Granada: del Beato Maestro Juan de Ávila, de Fray Bartolomé de los Mártires, del cardenal-rey Don Enrique de Portugal, de la madre Ana de la Concepción, de doña Elvira de Mendoza y de Melicia Hernández.
description.en-US: The lives written by Fray Luis de Granada: of Blessed Master John of Ávila, of Fray Bartholomew of the Martyrs, of the cardinal-king Henry of Portugal, of Mother Ana de la Concepción, of Doña Elvira de Mendoza and of Melicia Hernández.
description.pt-BR: As vidas escritas por Frei Luís de Granada: do Beato Mestre João de Ávila, de Frei Bartolomeu dos Mártires, do cardeal-rei Henrique de Portugal, da madre Ana da Conceição, de dona Elvira de Mendoza e de Melícia Hernández.

sources.edition: Fr. Luis de Granada, Obras, ed. Justo Cuervo OP, vol. 14 (Madrid: Viuda e hija de Gómez Fuentenebro, 1906-1908). Text of the pieces as Cuervo prints them.
sources.description: Six lives. Cuervo's variants and appendix documents are not imported. OCR of the University of Toronto scan, cleaned by script (running heads, page numbers and the editor's prologue removed; lost initial capitals restored from the corpus vocabulary), not proofread.
sources.tierEvidence: Granada's text of the 16th century, reprinted in 1906; Cuervo's edition is in the public domain on archive.org.
